# Setup
```{r}
library(infercnv)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(readxl)
library(sf)
library(corrplot)
library(png) 
library(grid)
library(terra)
library(FNN)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(mclust)
library(aricode)
library(fastCNV)
library(fastCNVdata)


root.dir <- "/Users/pengja/PennNeurosurgery Dropbox/Jackie Peng/SilverbushLab/Projects/Jackie_post-mortem/"
suppressWarnings(source(paste0(root.dir, "Code/", 'helper_functions.R')))

raw.data.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "RawData/", "spaceranger_output/")
processed.data.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "my_data/", "autopsy/")
results.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Results/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", "visium/")

sample.id <- "P2_S1"

if (sample.id == "P2_S1") {
  microns_per_pixel <- 0.5034168114587909
} else if (sample.id == "P1_A5") {
  microns_per_pixel <- 0.5033895166215644
} else if (sample.id == "P2_S8") {
  microns_per_pixel <- 0.503392923917596
} else if (sample.id == "P2_S11") {
  microns_per_pixel <- 0.5034411112485763
}


filter <- T
denoise <- F
denoise.vars.to.regress <- c("heat.shock.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature")
denoise.vars.to.regress <- sort(denoise.vars.to.regress)

if (denoise) {
  denoise.label <- paste0(denoise.vars.to.regress, collapse = "_")
} else {
  denoise.label <- FALSE
}

output.dir <- paste0(results.dir, sample.id, "/")
dir.create(output.dir)

output.dir <- paste0(output.dir, sample.id, "_denoise.", denoise.label, "_filter.", filter, "/")
dir.create(output.dir)
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "qc/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "oligos/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "markers/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "inferCNV/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "malignant/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "clusters/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "ligand_receptor/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "seurat_objs/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "segmented/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "segmented/", "qc/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "segmented/", "oligos/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "segmented/", "spatial/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "segmented/", "spatial/", "oligos_only/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "segmented/", "spatial/", "interactions/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "segmented/", "spatial/", "by_gene/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "segmented/", "by_cluster/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "segmented/", "by_gene/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "segmented/", "spatial/", "features/"))
dir.create(paste0(output.dir, "seurat_objs/"))


oligo.jakel2019.signatures[["Oligo4"]] <- NULL # not enough genes

set.seed(123)

if (sample.id %in% c("P1_A5", "P2_S1")) {
  visium.data.dir <- paste0(raw.data.dir, "HTS_SO187/")
} else {
  visium.data.dir <- paste0(raw.data.dir, "HTS_SO231/")
}

spatial.featureplot.scale.fill <- scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno")
spatial.featureplot.scale.color <- scale_color_viridis_c(option = "inferno")

radius.use.spatial <- 100
```



# Read in Seurat data
```{r}
counts <- Read10X(paste0(visium.data.dir, sample.id, "_Visium_HD", "/", "segmented_outputs/", "filtered_feature_cell_matrix/"))
seurat.obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts)
seurat.obj$sample.id <- sample.id


##### update segmented object with size and coordinates of cell/nucleus #####
cell_segmentations <- st_read(paste0(visium.data.dir, sample.id, "_Visium_HD", "/", "segmented_outputs/", "cell_segmentations.geojson"))
cell_segmentations$seurat_cell_id <- sprintf(
  "cellid_%09d-1",
  as.integer(cell_segmentations$cell_id)
)



nucleus_segmentations <- st_read(paste0(visium.data.dir, sample.id, "_Visium_HD", "/", "segmented_outputs/", "nucleus_segmentations.geojson"))
nucleus_segmentations$seurat_cell_id <- sprintf(
  "cellid_%09d-1",
  as.integer(nucleus_segmentations$cell_id)
)

centroids <- st_point_on_surface(nucleus_segmentations)
coords <- st_coordinates(centroids)


centroid_df <- data.frame(
  cell_id = nucleus_segmentations$seurat_cell_id,
  nucleus.x = coords[,1],
  nucleus.y = coords[,2]
)
rownames(centroid_df) <- centroid_df$cell_id

centroid_df$x.microns <- centroid_df$nucleus.x * microns_per_pixel
centroid_df$y.microns <- centroid_df$nucleus.y * microns_per_pixel

seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, centroid_df)
seurat.obj$x <- seurat.obj$nucleus.x
seurat.obj$y <- seurat.obj$nucleus.y

```

```{r}
seurat.obj$filter.out <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[["percent.mt"]]) > 20) | (as.numeric(row[["nCount_RNA"]]) < 20))

final.features <- names(var.features[var.features > 0])

# Re-run the plot with final.features
p <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj, 
             features = final.features, 
             group.by = "seurat_clusters", 
             flip = TRUE,
```

# DEGs by clusters
```{r}
find.markers <- T

if (find.markers) {
  #seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(output.dir, "seurat_objs/", "segmented.seurat.obj.RDS"))
  Idents(seurat.obj) <- "seurat_clusters"
  markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat.obj)
  write.table(markers, paste0(output.dir, "segmented/", "by_cluster/", "seurat_clusters_markers.tsv"), row.names = F, sep = "\t", quote = F)
  
  markers <- read.csv(paste0(output.dir, "segmented/", "by_cluster/", "seurat_clusters_markers.tsv"), sep = "\t")
  markers.filter <- markers %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.5) %>% arrange(desc(avg_log2FC))
  
  for (i in sort(unique(markers.filter$cluster))) {
    print(paste0("cluster ", i))
    markers.filter %>% filter(cluster == i) %>% head(100) %>% pull(gene) %>% paste(collapse = " ") %>% print()
  }
}
```



# Read in H&E image
```{r}
seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(output.dir, "seurat_objs/", "segmented.seurat.obj.RDS"))


# capture area of Visium HD
x.min <- range(seurat.obj$x)[1]
x.max <- range(seurat.obj$x)[2]
y.min <- range(seurat.obj$y)[1]
y.max <- range(seurat.obj$y)[2]

#r <- rast(paste0(visium.data.dir, sample.id, "_Visium_HD", "/", "spatial/", "tissue_hires_image.png"))
#r <- rast(paste0(visium.data.dir, sample.id, "_Visium_HD", "/", "spatial/", "tissue_lowres_image.png"))


if (sample.id == "P2_S1") {
  he.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "RawData/", "visium_images/", "P1_A5_P2_S1/", "HE/")
  r <- rast(paste0(he.dir, "HTS_SO187_08_P2_S1_Visium_HD_Lane_2.tif"))
} else if (sample.id == "P1_A5") {
  he.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "RawData/", "visium_images/", "P1_A5_P2_S1/", "HE/")
  r <- rast(paste0(he.dir, "HTS_SO187_07_P1_A5_Visium_HD_Lane_2.tif"))
} else if (sample.id == "P2_S8") {
  he.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "RawData/", "visium_images/",  "P2_S11_P2_S8/", "HE/")
  r <- rast(paste0(he.dir, "HTS_SO231_01_Visium_HD_P2_S8_S1_L001_HE.tif"))
} else if (sample.id == "P2_S11") {
  he.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "RawData/", "visium_images/",  "P2_S11_P2_S8/", "HE/")
  r <- rast(paste0(he.dir, "HTS_SO231_02_Visium_HD_P2_S11_S2_L001_HE.tif"))
}

# crop to Visium HD capture area
crop_ext <- ext(
  x.min, x.max,
  y.min, y.max
)

r_crop <- crop(r, crop_ext)
r_df <- as.data.frame(r_crop, xy = TRUE)
colnames(r_df)[1:5] <- c("x", "y", "r", "g", "b")
r_df %>% head()
r_df <- na.omit(r_df)
range(r_df$x)

r_small <- aggregate(r, fact = 4, fun = mean)
r_small_crop <- crop(r_small, crop_ext)
r_small_df <- as.data.frame(r_small_crop, xy = TRUE)
colnames(r_small_df)[1:5] <- c("x", "y", "r", "g", "b")
r_small_df %>% head()

range(r_small_df$x)

save.tiff <- F
if (save.tiff) {
  r_flipped <- flip(r_crop, direction = "vertical")
  terra::writeRaster(r_flipped, paste0(he.dir, sample.id, "_HE_cropped.tif"), 
                     overwrite = TRUE,
                     datatype = "INT1U", 
                     gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW", "TILING=YES"))
}

```

```{r}
#seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(output.dir, "seurat_objs/", "segmented.seurat.obj.w.annotations.RDS"))


save.geojson <- T

if (save.geojson) {
  
  # save annotations as geojson
  library(sf)
  library(dplyr)
  library(jsonlite)
  library(geojsonsf)
  library(tibble)
  
  # -----------------------------
  # User settings
  # -----------------------------
  
  celltype_col <- "celltype.refined"
  
  output_gz <- paste0(
    output.dir,
    "seurat_objs/",
    "cell_segmentations_qupath_classes_combined.geojson.gz"
  )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # 1. Create combined cell type + cluster annotation
  # -----------------------------
  
  print(table(seurat.obj$celltype.by.cluster.split))
  
  # -----------------------------
  # 2. Extract Seurat metadata
  # -----------------------------
  
  meta <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>%
    rownames_to_column("seurat_cell_id")
  
  # -----------------------------
  # 3. Join Seurat annotations onto cell segmentation sf object
  # -----------------------------
  
  gdf <- cell_segmentations %>%
    left_join(
      meta %>%
        select(seurat_cell_id, class_name = all_of(celltype_col)),
      by = "seurat_cell_id"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(class_name))
  
  print(table(gdf$class_name))
  
  # QuPath expects image/pixel coordinates, not geographic CRS
  sf::st_crs(gdf) <- NA
  
  # -----------------------------
  # 4. Clean geometries before grouping
  # -----------------------------
  
  # Remove empty geometries
  gdf <- gdf %>%
    filter(!sf::st_is_empty(geometry))
  
  # Repair invalid polygons
  gdf <- sf::st_make_valid(gdf)
  
  # If repair creates geometry collections, keep only polygonal pieces
  gdf <- sf::st_collection_extract(gdf, "POLYGON")
  
  # Remove any empty geometries created during repair/extraction
  gdf <- gdf %>%
    filter(!sf::st_is_empty(geometry))
  
  # Optional aggressive fallback for self-crossing geometries
  # This usually helps with "edge crosses edge" errors
  gdf$geometry <- sf::st_buffer(gdf$geometry, 0)
  
  # Repair again after buffer
  gdf <- sf::st_make_valid(gdf)
  gdf <- sf::st_collection_extract(gdf, "POLYGON")
  
  gdf <- gdf %>%
    filter(!sf::st_is_empty(geometry))
  
  bad <- which(!sf::st_is_valid(gdf))
  message("Invalid geometries after repair: ", length(bad))
  
  if (length(bad) > 0) {
    gdf <- gdf[-bad, ]
    message("Dropped invalid geometries: ", length(bad))
  }
  
  # -----------------------------
  # 5. Combine all geometries of the same class
  # -----------------------------
  # st_combine creates one MULTIPOLYGON-like geometry per class without
  # dissolving boundaries. This is safer than st_union for segmentation data.
  
  gdf_by_class <- gdf %>%
    group_by(class_name) %>%
    summarise(
      geometry = sf::st_combine(geometry),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Final repair
  gdf_by_class <- sf::st_make_valid(gdf_by_class)
  gdf_by_class <- sf::st_collection_extract(gdf_by_class, "POLYGON")
  
  sf::st_crs(gdf_by_class) <- NA
  
  print(gdf_by_class)
  
  # -----------------------------
  # 6. Define QuPath class colors
  # -----------------------------
  
  class_names <- sort(unique(gdf_by_class$class_name))
  
  palette <- grDevices::rainbow(length(class_names))
  
  rgb_to_int <- function(hex) {
    rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(hex)
    as.integer(rgb[1, ] * 65536 + rgb[2, ] * 256 + rgb[3, ])
  }
  
  color_map <- setNames(
    rgb_to_int(palette),
    class_names
  )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # 7. Convert geometries to GeoJSON geometry objects
  # -----------------------------
  
  geom_json <- geojsonsf::sfc_geojson(sf::st_geometry(gdf_by_class))
  
  # -----------------------------
  # 8. Generate one GeoJSON feature per class
  # -----------------------------
  
  features <- vector("list", nrow(gdf_by_class))
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(gdf_by_class))) {
    class_name <- as.character(gdf_by_class$class_name[i])
  
    features[[i]] <- list(
      type = "Feature",
      geometry = jsonlite::fromJSON(
        geom_json[i],
        simplifyVector = FALSE
      ),
      properties = list(
        object_type = "annotation",
        name = class_name,
        classification = list(
          name = class_name,
          colorRGB = unname(color_map[class_name])
        )
      )
    )
  }
  
  geojson_output <- list(
    type = "FeatureCollection",
    features = features
  )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # 9. Save directly as compressed GeoJSON
  # -----------------------------
  
  dir.create(
    dirname(output_gz),
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
  
  con <- gzfile(output_gz, open = "wt", encoding = "UTF-8")
  
  jsonlite::write_json(
    geojson_output,
    con,
    auto_unbox = TRUE,
    pretty = FALSE
  )
  
  close(con)
  
  message("Saved compressed QuPath GeoJSON to: ", output_gz)
}
```

# Neighborhood analysis, GBM FGF- vs FGF+
FGF- vs FGF+ neighborhood
```{r}
# --- CONFIGURATION ---
fgf_ligands    <- c("FGF1", "FGF2")  # or just "FGF2" for FGF2-only
fgf.cutoff     <- 0
radius.use     <- radius.use.spatial

neighborhood.dir <- paste0(output.dir, "segmented/", "neighborhood_radius=", radius.use, "_microns/")
dir.create(neighborhood.dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

gbm_celltypes <- c("MES-like", "AC-like", "OPC-like", "NPC-like")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load data & fetch gene expression into metadata
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(output.dir, "seurat_objs/", "segmented.seurat.obj.w.annotations.RDS"))

gene_vars  <- c("FGF1", "FGF2", "FGFR1", "FGFR2")
seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, FetchData(seurat.obj, vars = gene_vars))
seurat.obj$celltype.original <- seurat.obj$celltype

centroid_df <- seurat.obj@meta.data[, c("cell_id", "x.microns", "y.microns")]
colnames(centroid_df) <- c("cell_id", "x", "y")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Subset oligos & add module scores
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
oligos <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = celltype == "Oligodendrocytes")
oligos <- add.module.score(oligos, oligo.gene.signatures)
oligos <- add.module.score(oligos, gene.signatures.gsea)
oligos <- add.module.score(oligos, fgfr.gene.signatures)
oligos <- add.module.score(oligos, fgf.gene.signatures)


  
fgf_label <- paste(fgf_ligands, collapse = ".")  # e.g. "FGF2" or "FGF1.FGF2"


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reclassify GBM subtypes according to gbm_group mode
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
seurat.obj@meta.data <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>%
  mutate(celltype = case_when(
    celltype.original %in% gbm_celltypes &
    rowSums(across(all_of(fgf_ligands)), na.rm = TRUE) >  fgf.cutoff ~ "FGFpos_GBM",

    celltype.original %in% gbm_celltypes &
    rowSums(across(all_of(fgf_ligands)), na.rm = TRUE) <= fgf.cutoff ~ "FGFneg_GBM",
    TRUE ~ celltype.original
  ))

all.celltypes <- sort(unique(seurat.obj$celltype))
print(all.celltypes)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Neighborhood composition around every oligo
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
oligo.neighborhood.df <- data.frame()

for (cell.id in oligos$cell_id) {
  neighborhood.cells <- get_cells_within_radius(
    centroids = centroid_df,
    center_id = cell.id,
    radius    = radius.use
  )

  neighorhood.df <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% filter(cell_id %in% neighborhood.cells)

  # Handle case where oligo has no neighbors within radius
  if (nrow(neighorhood.df) == 0) {
    df <- data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = length(all.celltypes)))
    colnames(df) <- all.celltypes
    df$cell_id <- cell.id
    df$n_neighbors <- 0
  } else {
    neighborhood.prop.df <- as.data.frame(table(Var1 = neighorhood.df$celltype))
    n.neighbors <- sum(neighborhood.prop.df$Freq)
    neighborhood.prop.df$fraction <- neighborhood.prop.df$Freq / n.neighbors
    neighborhood.prop.df$Freq     <- NULL
    df <- neighborhood.prop.df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Var1, values_from = fraction)
    for (ct in setdiff(all.celltypes, colnames(df))) df[ct] <- 0
    df$cell_id <- cell.id
    df$n_neighbors <- n.neighbors
  }

  oligo.neighborhood.df <- rbind(oligo.neighborhood.df, df)
}

oligo.neighborhood.df <- data.frame(oligo.neighborhood.df)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Add neighborhood fractions back to oligos Seurat object
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

# Set rownames BEFORE adding the suffix
rownames(oligo.neighborhood.df) <- oligo.neighborhood.df$cell_id

# Remove cell_id column and add suffix to the rest
oligo.neighborhood.df$cell_id <- NULL
colnames(oligo.neighborhood.df) <- sapply(colnames(oligo.neighborhood.df), function(x) ifelse(x != "n_neighbors", paste0(x, "_nb_frac"), x))

oligos <- AddMetaData(oligos, oligo.neighborhood.df)

oligos.metadata.df <- oligos@meta.data

#oligos.metadata.df <- oligos.metadata.df %>% filter(seurat_clusters != "16")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Neighborhood annotation
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

# Neighborhood fraction column names (R converts - to . in column names)
fgf_pos_col <- "FGFpos_GBM_nb_frac"
fgf_neg_col <- "FGFneg_GBM_nb_frac"

oligos.metadata.df$neighborhood.annotation <- case_when(
  oligos.metadata.df[[fgf_pos_col]] > fgf.cutoff ~ paste0("GBM ", fgf_label, "+"),
  oligos.metadata.df[[fgf_neg_col]] > fgf.cutoff ~ paste0("GBM ", fgf_label, "-"),
  TRUE ~ "GBM-"
)

oligos.metadata.df$neighborhood.annotation <- factor(
  oligos.metadata.df$neighborhood.annotation,
```

# Interaction plotting
```{r}
library(ggnewscale)
plot_spatial_interaction <- function(data, 
                                     target_gbm_type = "MES-like", 
                                     ligands = c("FGF1", "FGF2"), 
                                     receptors = c("FGFR1", "FGFR2"),
                                     save_plot = TRUE,
                                     output_dir = paste0(output.dir, "segmented/", "spatial/", "interactions/")) {
  
  # 1. Filter Ligand Cells (GBM)
  if (target_gbm_type == "All-GBM") {
    ligand_data <- data %>% filter(grepl("like", celltype))
  } else {
    ligand_data <- data %>% filter(celltype == target_gbm_type)
  }
  
  # Calculate Ligand Score (Average if multiple)
  ligand_label <- paste(ligands, collapse = "+")
  if (length(ligands) > 1) {
    ligand_data$ligand_score <- rowMeans(ligand_data[, ligands, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    ligand_data$ligand_score <- ligand_data[[ligands]]
  }
  
  ligand_signal <- ligand_data %>% filter(ligand_score > 0) %>% arrange(ligand_score)
  
  # 2. Filter Receptor Cells (Oligos)
  oligo_data <- data %>% filter(celltype == "Oligodendrocytes")
  
  # Calculate Receptor Score (Average if multiple)
  receptor_label <- paste(receptors, collapse = "+")
  if (length(receptors) > 1) {
    oligo_data$receptor_score <- rowMeans(oligo_data[, receptors, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    oligo_data$receptor_score <- oligo_data[[receptors]]
  }
  
  oligo_signal <- oligo_data %>% filter(receptor_score > 0) %>% arrange(receptor_score)
  
  # 3. Define Background
  background_cells <- data %>%
    filter(!(cell_id %in% ligand_signal$cell_id) & !(cell_id %in% oligo_signal$cell_id))
  
  # 4. Create Plot
  plot_title <- paste0(target_gbm_type, " (", ligand_label, ") -> Oligos (", receptor_label, ")")
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Background
    geom_point(data = background_cells, aes(x.microns, y.microns), color = "gray15", size = 0.4) +
    
    # Receptor Layer (Blue)
    geom_point(data = oligo_signal, aes(x.microns, y.microns, color = receptor_score), size = 0.8) +
    scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("#000044", "#377EB8", "#A6CEE3"), 
                          name = paste("Oligo", receptor_label),
                          limits = quantile(oligo_signal$receptor_score, c(0.05, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE),
                          oob = scales::squish) +
    
    # Ligand Layer (Red)
    new_scale_color() +
    geom_point(data = ligand_signal, aes(x.microns, y.microns, color = ligand_score), size = 0.8) +
    scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("#440000", "#E41A1C", "#FB9A99"), 
                          name = paste(target_gbm_type, ligand_label),
                          limits = quantile(ligand_signal$ligand_score, c(0.05, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE),
                          oob = scales::squish) +
    
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_void() + 
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
      legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
      legend.title = element_text(color = "white", size = 8, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(color = "white", hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "white"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "white"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(colour = "white"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "white")
    ) +
    labs(title = plot_title) +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    xlab("x (microns)") +
    ylab("y (microns)")
  
  # 5. Save or Return
  if (save_plot) {
    # Fix 1: use ligand_label and receptor_label, not undefined target_ligand/target_receptor
    pdf(paste0(output_dir, "spatial_", target_gbm_type, "_", ligand_label, "_to_", receptor_label, ".pdf"), 
        width = 11, height = 8)
    print(p)
    dev.off()
  }
  
  return(p)  # Fix 3: always return the plot
}
```

# Quantify interaction spatially
```{r}
library(RANN)

run_spatial_interaction <- function(
    metadata.df,
    ligands    = c("FGF1", "FGF2"),   # one or both of FGF1, FGF2
    receptors  = c("FGFR1", "FGFR2"), # one or both of FGFR1, FGFR2
    dist_threshold = radius.use.spatial,
    min_pairs      = 0,
    output_dir     = paste0(output.dir, "segmented/", "spatial/", "interactions/")
) {
  
  # --- Derived labels ---
  ligand_label   <- paste(ligands,    collapse = "/")
  receptor_label <- paste(receptors,  collapse = "/")
  
  # --- Composite score helpers ---
  # Average across genes if multiple, otherwise use single column directly
  score_cols <- function(df, genes) {
    #if (length(genes) > 1) rowMeans(df[, genes, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    if (length(genes) > 1) rowSums(df[, genes, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    else df[[genes]]
  }
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Identify Receiver population (Oligos with receptor score > 0)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  oligo_all <- metadata.df %>% filter(celltype == "Oligodendrocytes")
  oligo_all$receptor_score <- score_cols(oligo_all, receptors)
  oligo_targets <- oligo_all %>% filter(receptor_score > 0)
  
  message(sprintf("Receivers: %d Oligodendrocytes with %s > 0", 
                  nrow(oligo_targets), receptor_label))
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Sender cell types
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  all_cell_types <- unique(metadata.df$celltype)
  all_cell_types <- all_cell_types[all_cell_types != "Oligodendrocytes"]
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Per-sender-type metrics
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  scatter_data <- lapply(all_cell_types, function(ct) {
    
    all_sender_cells <- metadata.df %>% filter(celltype == ct)
    all_sender_cells$ligand_score <- score_cols(all_sender_cells, ligands)
    
    # Mean ligand expression across ALL cells of this type (includes zeros)
    mean_ligand_expr   <- mean(all_sender_cells$ligand_score, na.rm = TRUE)
    percent_expressing <- 100 * mean(
      rowSums(all_sender_cells[, ligands, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
        
    sender_cells <- all_sender_cells %>% filter(ligand_score > 0)
    
    # Need at least 1 expressing sender cell to do NN search
    if (nrow(sender_cells) == 0) {
      return(data.frame(
        CellType           = ct,
        Median_Distance    = NA,
        N_Niche_Pairs      = 0,
        Status             = "No Expressing Senders",
        mean_ligand_expr   = mean_ligand_expr,
        percent_expressing = percent_expressing
      ))
    }
    
    # Nearest ligand+ sender for every receptor+ oligo
    nn <- nn2(
      data  = sender_cells[, c("x.microns", "y.microns")],
      query = oligo_targets[, c("x.microns", "y.microns")],
      k     = 1
    )
    
    all_pairs <- data.frame(
      oligo_expr    = oligo_targets$receptor_score,
      neighbor_expr = sender_cells$ligand_score[nn$nn.idx],
      distance      = nn$nn.dists[, 1]
    )
    
    global_median_dist <- median(all_pairs$distance)
    niche_pairs        <- all_pairs %>% filter(distance <= dist_threshold)
    
    status <- if (nrow(niche_pairs) >= min_pairs) "Valid" else "Insufficient Pairs"
    
    data.frame(
      CellType           = ct,
      Median_Distance    = global_median_dist,
      N_Niche_Pairs      = nrow(niche_pairs),
      Status             = status,
      mean_ligand_expr   = mean_ligand_expr,
      percent_expressing = percent_expressing
    )
  })
  
  plot_df <- bind_rows(scatter_data) %>% filter(Status == "Valid")
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Plot
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  y_label <- ifelse(grepl("/", ligand_label), sprintf("Sum of %s expression", ligand_label), sprintf("%s expression", ligand_label))
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Median_Distance, y = mean_ligand_expr, label = CellType)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = N_Niche_Pairs, color = percent_expressing), alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Percent\nExpression") +
    geom_text(vjust = -1.2, size = 4, check_overlap = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("%s -> %s interaction by cell type", ligand_label, receptor_label),
      y     = y_label,
      x     = sprintf("Median distance to nearest %s+ cell (um)", ligand_label),
      size  = sprintf("Pairs in niche\n(< %d um)", dist_threshold)
    )
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Save
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  fname <- sprintf("FGF_interaction_%s_to_%s.pdf", ligand_label, receptor_label)
  fname <- str_replace_all(fname, "/", ".")
  pdf(paste0(output_dir, fname), width = 12, height = 8)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  message("Saved: ", fname)
  
  invisible(plot_df)  # return data silently for downstream use
}
```

# FGFR downstream signaling
```{r}
run_ligand_signaling_correlation <- function(
    metadata.df,
    target_celltype    = "Oligodendrocytes",
    sender_celltypes   = c("MES-like", "AC-like", "OPC-like", "NPC-like"),
    ligands            = c("FGF1", "FGF2"),
    signaling_score    = "fgfr_signaling_score",
    dist_threshold     = radius.use.spatial,   # used for boxplot: near vs far split
    neighbor_radius    = radius.use.spatial,   # used for scatter: radius to sum ligand expression
    output_dir         = paste0(output.dir, "segmented/spatial/interactions/signaling/")
) {
  
  ligand_label <- paste(ligands, collapse = "/")
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Target cells (receptor side)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  target_cells <- metadata.df %>% filter(celltype == target_celltype)
  target_cells$signaling_score <- target_cells[[signaling_score]]

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Sender cells (ligand side)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  sender_cells <- metadata.df %>% filter(celltype %in% sender_celltypes)
  sender_cells$ligand_score <- rowSums(sender_cells[, ligands, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  sender_cells <- sender_cells %>% filter(ligand_score > 0)
  
  message(sprintf("%d %s cells with %s > 0", nrow(sender_cells), 
                  paste(sender_celltypes, collapse = "/"), ligand_label))
  
  if (nrow(sender_cells) == 0) {
    message(sprintf("No sender cells expressing %s found in: %s", 
                    ligand_label, paste(sender_celltypes, collapse = ", ")))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. For each target cell, sum ligand expression within neighbor_radius
  #    and get nearest neighbor distance for boxplot split
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  nn_all <- nn2(
    data  = sender_cells[, c("x.microns", "y.microns")],
    query = target_cells[, c("x.microns", "y.microns")],
    k     = nrow(sender_cells)
  )
  
  # Sum ligand expression within neighbor_radius (for scatter)
  ligand_sum <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(target_cells)), function(i) {
    within_radius <- nn_all$nn.dists[i, ] <= neighbor_radius
    sum(sender_cells$ligand_score[nn_all$nn.idx[i, within_radius]], na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  
  # Nearest neighbor distance (for boxplot split)
  nearest_dist <- nn_all$nn.dists[, 1]
  
  pair_df <- data.frame(
    cell_id         = target_cells$cell_id,
    signaling_score = target_cells$signaling_score,
    ligand_sum      = ligand_sum,
    nearest_dist    = nearest_dist
  )
  
  message(sprintf("%d target cells; %d have at least one ligand+ neighbor within %d um",
                  nrow(pair_df), sum(ligand_sum > 0), neighbor_radius))
  
  if (nrow(pair_df) < 3) {
    message("Too few pairs for correlation — try increasing neighbor_radius")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Correlation test (ligand sum vs signaling score)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  cor_res <- cor.test(pair_df$ligand_sum, pair_df$signaling_score, method = "spearman")
  
  cor_label <- sprintf("Spearman rho = %.3f\np = %.2e\nn = %d",
                       cor_res$estimate, cor_res$p.value, nrow(pair_df))
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Plot A: scatter — total ligand within neighbor_radius vs signaling score
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  p_scatter <- ggplot(pair_df, aes(x = ligand_sum, y = signaling_score)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = cor_label,
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 6) +
    labs(
      title = "GBM -> Oligodendrocytes",
      x     = sprintf("Total %s expression within %d um", ligand_label, neighbor_radius),
      y     = signaling_score
    ) +
    theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12))
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Plot B: boxplot — near vs far split using dist_threshold
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  negative.label <- paste0(">", dist_threshold, " um")
  positive.label <- paste0("<=", dist_threshold, " um")
  
  all_target_df <- pair_df %>%
    mutate(proximity = ifelse(nearest_dist <= dist_threshold,
                              positive.label,
                              negative.label))
  all_target_df$proximity <- factor(all_target_df$proximity, levels = c(positive.label, negative.label))
  
  stat_test <- all_target_df %>%
    wilcox_test(signaling_score ~ proximity, alternative = "greater") %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
    add_significance() %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "proximity")
  stat_test$p.label <- sapply(stat_test$p.adj, format.p.value)
  
  p_box <- ggplot(all_target_df, aes(x = proximity, y = signaling_score)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), alpha = 0.1, size = 1) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat_test, label = "p.label", label.size = 6) +
    labs(
      title = "GBM -> Oligodendrocytes",
      x     = sprintf("Nearest %s+ neighbor", ligand_label),
      y     = signaling_score
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12)) +
    stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 3, fill = "red")
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. Save
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  fname_scatter <- sprintf("%s%s_ligandscore_vs_signaling_scatter_%s.pdf", 
                           output_dir, str_replace_all(ligand_label, "/", "."), signaling_score)
  pdf(fname_scatter, width = 11, height = 8)
  print(p_scatter)
  dev.off()
  
  fname_box <- sprintf("%s%s_ligand_proximity_vs_signaling_boxplot_%s.pdf", 
                       output_dir, str_replace_all(ligand_label, "/", "."), signaling_score)
  pdf(fname_box, width = 8, height = 8)
  print(p_box)
  dev.off()
  
  message("Saved: ", fname_scatter)
  message("Saved: ", fname_box)
  
  invisible(list(pairs = pair_df, all_targets = all_target_df, cor = cor_res))
}
```

```{r}
for (i in seq_along(df_list)) {
  
  current_df <- df_list[[i]]
  current_sample <- unique(current_df$sample.desc)
  
  # 1. Add cell counts to create the dynamic x-axis strings
  current_df <- current_df %>%
    group_by(neighborhood.annotation) %>%
    mutate(
      n_cells = n(),
      labeled_neighborhood = paste0(neighborhood.annotation, "\n(n=", n_cells, ")")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # 2. FORCE THE X-AXIS ORDER
  # We look up what the dynamic string names became for your three target groups
  gbm_neg_label <- current_df %>% filter(neighborhood.annotation == "GBM-") %>% pull(labeled_neighborhood) %>% unique()
  fgf_neg_label <- current_df %>% filter(neighborhood.annotation == "GBM FGF1/2-") %>% pull(labeled_neighborhood) %>% unique()
  fgf_pos_label <- current_df %>% filter(neighborhood.annotation == "GBM FGF1/2+") %>% pull(labeled_neighborhood) %>% unique()
  
  # Convert to factor using your explicit sequence order
  current_df <- current_df %>%
    mutate(labeled_neighborhood = factor(labeled_neighborhood, levels = c(gbm_neg_label, fgf_neg_label, fgf_pos_label)))
  
  # 3. Run the statistical test on the clean strings
  stat.test <- current_df %>%
    wilcox_test(reactive.oligo.general ~ neighborhood.annotation,
                comparisons = list(c("GBM-", "GBM FGF1/2-"), c("GBM FGF1/2-", "GBM FGF1/2+"), c("GBM-", "GBM FGF1/2+")),
                alternative = "less") %>%
    add_significance() %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr")
  
  # 4. Create a clean lookup table to map the names
  label_mapping <- current_df %>% 
    distinct(neighborhood.annotation, labeled_neighborhood)
  
  # 5. Swap the original group1/group2 names with the exact (n=X) strings
  stat.test <- stat.test %>%
    left_join(label_mapping, by = c("group1" = "neighborhood.annotation")) %>%
    mutate(group1 = as.character(labeled_neighborhood)) %>% 
    select(-labeled_neighborhood) %>%
    left_join(label_mapping, by = c("group2" = "neighborhood.annotation")) %>%
    mutate(group2 = as.character(labeled_neighborhood)) %>% 
    select(-labeled_neighborhood)
  
  # 6. Calculate bracket coordinates using the factor column
  stat.test <- stat.test %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "labeled_neighborhood", data = current_df, formula = reactive.oligo.general ~ labeled_neighborhood)
  
  stat.test$p.label <- sapply(stat.test$p.adj, format.p.value)
  
  # 7. Build the individual plot using your exact format
  # p <- ggplot(current_df, aes(labeled_neighborhood, reactive.oligo.general, color = labeled_neighborhood)) +
  #   geom_boxplot() +
  #   theme(
  #     axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
  #     legend.position = "none"
  #   ) +
  #   labs(
  #     title = current_sample, 
  #     x = "Neighborhood", 
  #     y = "Reactive oligo signature"
  #   ) +
  #   stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.label", label.size = 6, step.increase = 0.1)
  
  
  p <- ggplot(current_df, aes(labeled_neighborhood, reactive.oligo.general, color = labeled_neighborhood)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Neighborhood (100 microns)", 
      y = "Reactive oligo signature"
    ) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.label", label.size = 6, step.increase = 0.1)
  
  plot_list[[i]] <- p
}

# Stitch them together side-by-side
#final_plot <- plot_list[[1]] + plot_list[[2]] + plot_list[[3]] + plot_layout(ncol = 3)

final_plot <- plot_list[[1]]
#pdf(paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Figure 5/", "FGF_neighborhood_vs_reactive.oligo.general_by_sample.desc.pdf"), width = 16, height = 8)
pdf(paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Figure 5/", "FGF_neighborhood_vs_reactive.oligo.general_P2_S1.pdf"), width = 10, height = 7)
print(final_plot)
dev.off()
```
